title: Page 3
content_zh:
“如果他真的对你怎么样，你就大声叫。”这就是左语恩非要留下来当守门员的原因。

席舞好笑地伸手拍拍她。“你放心，如果他真的要对我怎么样，我应该没空可以大叫。”

“为什么？”

齐藤英树的身手了得，这么多年过去，也许可以神出鬼没了。

席舞想归想，可没多说什么，却把相机先交给了她。“你要等就等，没事可以选一下你要用的照片，我马上出来。”

说完，席舞便再次走进房，关上了门，那男人正站在窗边，一身的冷意。

“齐藤先生找我有什么事？”席舞试着让说话的嗓音平稳。

可是当这男人缓缓朝她走来，越靠越近，甚至连说话的气息都吹拂上她的脸时，她还是忍不住退了一步——

一只手却抓住了她纤细的手臂，不让她有退却的空间，另一只手以迅雷不及掩耳的速度摘下她脸上的眼镜！

“啊。”席舞惊叫出声。

他终于看见了她的脸。

雪白典雅的容颜，似曾相识，却又不是那个他以为的舞冬末。

她的眉、她的眼都酷似着某人，可整张脸摆在他面前，却似乎少了点什么……

她不是舞冬末？

有那么一瞬间，他的心再一次跌入谷底。不过他很快克服了它，毕竟九年过去，他经历过太多次的希望与失望，早已练就一身波澜不兴的好本事。

他甚至想过任何一个可能性，如果她没死……

她可能坠崖失忆了，忘了他，因为她根本不想再记得过去。

她可能坠崖受了重伤，变成了残废，所以不愿意再回来，或是根本不想再回来。

她可能因为受伤整了容，变了脸，让他就算遇见她也认不出她来。

每一个可能性他都想过，过去九年，任何一个身高身形年纪与她相仿，曾经出入境日本和台湾的女人，他几乎无一错漏过，有的甚至必须他亲自确认，却从来没有一个像眼前的这位那样让他感到熟悉。

还有，她叫席舞呵，名字里有个舞字，是因为她念旧的个性，不愿舍弃过往曾经的存在吧？如果她真的是舞冬末，还可由此断定她绝非失忆，因为一个失忆的女人就算另外取名字，也不会刚好就取了个舞字。

是万分之一的念想呵，相信席舞就是舞冬末。

就连那背影都让他心心念念着，何况眼前这女人眉眼之间给他的熟悉感呢？还有她的发香……

是吧？她是舞冬末吧？

就算她不认他，他也认得出她来！

齐藤英树盯着她粉嫩的唇瓣，好看修长的指轻轻地摩挲着它们，席舞动也不敢动一下，整个人都颤着。

心，在狂跳。

光是让这男人深情不已地瞅着，她全身都似要化为水，无力又虚弱不已。

“齐藤先生，你干什么？快放开我！”她很努力地表现出她的不悦与抗议，这男人却只是把眉挑得更高。

“有件事我必须确定一下。”

“什么？”她紧张不已地盯着他瞧，那越来越近、越来越近的一张俊颜，迫得她不得不想着要逃。

可他哪能容她逃开？他需要确定的事，得她配合才行……想着，齐藤英树蓦地展臂将她整个圈入怀中，俯首便亲吻上她。

“唔……”席舞没料到他竟会如此待她，根本猝不及防，整个人便深陷在他霸气的亲吻中。

这吻，不同于九年前的温柔低吮，带着一股浓浓的霸气，极尽地探入勾缠，近乎贪婪的，像是要把她给卷入他，竟让她有点害怕了。

像是惩罚。

席舞慢半拍地才想到挣扎，可手软脚软，心慌意乱，根本不得章法，那挣扎倒似撒娇，显得欲拒还迎。

“你……放开我……”

她握住的拳头落在他宽大厚实的胸膛，像雨点打在他身上，根本不痛不痒。

可终究，他还是放开了她，圏住的双臂却未曾松开。

齐藤英树幽深的黑眸定定地落在她脸上，盯着她红透又带着羞恼的面容，还有她那两片被他吻得微微红肿的红唇，眸光又是一黯，感觉身体的某处正紧绷着；他知道那个东西叫欲望，而他已经很久没有这种感觉。

吻，很美好。

她抱起来的感觉，就像他记忆中的她。

经过这一吻、这深深的拥抱，他几乎要认定了她就是舞冬末。

或者说，不管她是不是舞冬末，他对这女人的渴望都是货真价实的——他想抱她，如果可以。

啪一声，一个巴掌打在他脸上——

“你以为你是谁？可以随便抓个女人想吻就吻吗？该死的，你凭什么吻我！你忘了你还有未婚妻蓝琳？”

“她不是我的未婚妻。”他淡淡说道，很甘愿地受她这一掌。

席舞气呼呼地瞪着他。“就算现在不是，以后也会是，你们的合作关系不是建立在可能的婚约基础上？”

这些可是左语恩亲口告诉她的！

齐藤英树扯扯唇。“你很在乎这个？”

他笑了。

他竟然该死的笑了？

“我当然不在乎！”她快被他气死。“你这人搞不清楚重点吗？重点是你不该吻我！不该随便吻一个陌生人！而且还是身边有别的女人时！你什么时候变得这么花心风流又滥情了？”

齐藤英树闻言眯起了眼，饱含深意地望着她。“你以前认识我吗？若不是，怎么知道我变了？”

“我……当然不认识你！”席舞真想咬掉自己的舌头。“只不过在杂志社工作总是听得到比较多内幕而已。”

“这内幕还包括知道我以前花不花心？风不风流？倒真有趣。”他冷哼几声，嘲弄地看着她。

席舞心虚地把眼睛瞪更大。“这不是重点好吗？重点是没有我的允许，你怎么可以随便吻我，连问都没问一句！”

齐藤英树笑了。“问了你会说好吗？”

“当然不会。”

“所以我为什么要问？”

说得好！真是有够无礼又霸道！不知是这男人本性如此？还是长大了就变得更坏了？

席舞又瞪他一眼，转身便要走。

“你的眼镜。”他好心提醒道。

闻言，她转过身把他手上的眼镜给拿回来，才又往外走。

就在她的手握住门把的那一刻，齐藤英树的嗓音再次冷冷地传来——

“你确定以前我们两个从来没见过？你对我一点印象都没有？”

握住门把的手紧了紧，席舞深吸了一口气才道：“我确定我以前不认识你，以后我也不想认识你。”

开门，离开，她没有回头，也不敢回头，只能挺直着身子往前走。

她要忘了他……

不要再伤心……

房内，看着她离去的齐藤英树拿起手机拨了一通电话——

“帮我查一个人，名叫席舞，还有，派人跟着她……”

第13章(1)

“席舞！等等我！”看见她一走出来就往前冲，左语恩忙不迭跟上，在后头追喊着，等终于追上她时，看见她脸上的泪不禁怔然。“席舞……你怎么了？怎么哭了？那个齐藤英树欺负你了？”

“我没事，我很好。”席舞伸手抹去泪，把眼镜还给了她，还对左语恩硬挤出一抹笑。“怎么样？有满意的照片吗？”

左语恩很顺手把眼镜给重新戴上并点点头。“嗯，非常非常满意的有好几张呢，你把他拍得太棒了……可是我看他这人很可恶，竟把你弄哭了，一点都配不上这照片上的形象！”

他，其实很好的，只是对她做过不好的事。

席舞很想这么说，可是她说不出口，也不能说。

“既然有满意的照片可以请我去吃大餐了吗？我现在好饿。”席舞可怜地抚了抚肚子。
content_en:
"If he really does anything to you, scream loudly." This is why Zuo Yuen insists on staying as a goalkeeper.

Xi Wu reached out and patted her funnyly."Don't worry, if he really wants to do something to me, I shouldn't have time to scream."

"Why?"

Saito Hideki's skills are so good that after so many years, he may be able to appear and disappear.

Xi Wu wanted to think about it, but didn't say anything more, but handed the camera to her first."Just wait if you want. If you have nothing else, you can choose the photo you want to use. I'll be out right away."

After saying that, Xi Wu walked into the room again and closed the door. The man was standing by the window, looking cold.

"Mr. Saito, what do you want from me?" Xi Wu tried to keep his voice steady.

But when this man slowly walked towards her, getting closer and closer, and even the breath of his words blew on her face, she couldn't help but take a step back——

One hand grabbed her slender arm, preventing her from retreating, and the other hand took off the glasses on her face at lightning speed!

"Ah." Xi Wu exclaimed.

He finally saw her face.

The snow-white and elegant face seemed familiar, but it was not the Wu Dongmo he thought he was.

Her eyebrows and her eyes all resembled someone, but when her face was placed in front of him, something seemed to be missing...

Isn’t she Wu Dongmo?

For a moment, his heart hit rock bottom again.But he quickly overcame it. After all, in the past nine years, he had experienced too many hopes and disappointments, and he had already developed the ability to stay calm.

He even thought about any possibility, if she was not dead...

She may have lost her memory after falling off a cliff and forgot about him, because she didn't want to remember the past at all.

She may have fallen off a cliff and been seriously injured and became disabled, so she didn't want to come back, or she didn't want to come back at all.

She might have had plastic surgery because of her injury, and her face had changed so that he wouldn't recognize her even if he met her.

He thought about every possibility. In the past nine years, he almost never missed any woman who was similar in height, body, age and had traveled to Japan and Taiwan. Some of them even required him to confirm in person, but none of them had ever seemed as familiar to him as the one in front of him.

Also, her name is Xi Wu, and there is a word for dance in her name. Is it because of her nostalgic personality and unwillingness to let go of her past existence?If she is really Wu Dongmo, we can also conclude that she is definitely not amnesiac, because even if a woman with amnesia chooses another name, she will not just choose the word Wu.

It’s one of the ten thousandth thoughts, I believe that Xi Wu is the end of Wu Dong.

Even the figure from behind made him think about it, not to mention the familiarity between the woman's eyebrows in front of him.And her hair fragrance...

Right?Is she Wu Dongmo?

Even if she didn't recognize him, he would recognize her!

Saito Hideki stared at her pink lips, his beautiful and slender fingers gently caressing them. Xi Wu did not dare to move, and his whole body was trembling.

The heart is beating wildly.

Just by letting this man look at her affectionately, her whole body seemed to turn into water, feeling powerless and weak.

"Mr. Saito, what are you doing? Let me go!" She tried very hard to show her displeasure and protest, but the man just raised his eyebrows higher.

"I have to make sure of something."

"What?" She stared at him nervously, the handsome face getting closer and closer, forcing her to think about running away.

But how could he allow her to escape?What he needs to confirm requires her cooperation... Thinking of this, Saito Hideki suddenly stretched out his arms to wrap her up in his arms, bowed his head and kissed her.

"Well..." Xi Wu didn't expect that he would treat her like this. She was caught off guard and fell into his domineering kiss.

This kiss was different from the gentle and low kiss nine years ago. It carried a strong domineering force and penetrated as far as possible. It was almost greedy, as if he wanted to involve her in him, which actually made her a little scared.

Like punishment.

Xi Wu took a moment to think of struggling, but her hands were soft and her feet were weak, and she was so flustered that she had no idea what to do. The struggle seemed like coquettishness, and she seemed to be trying to resist but to welcome him.

"You... let me go..."

Her clenched fist fell on his broad and thick chest, like raindrops hitting him, without any pain or itch at all.

But in the end, he let her go, without letting go of his arms.

Saito Hideki's deep black eyes were fixed on her face, staring at her red and embarrassed face, and her two red lips that were slightly red and swollen from his kiss. His eyes dimmed again, and he felt that somewhere in his body was tense; he knew that thing was called desire, and he had not felt this way for a long time.

The kiss was beautiful.

The feeling of holding her was just like how he remembered her.

After this kiss and this deep hug, he almost recognized that she was Wu Dongmo.

In other words, regardless of whether she was Wu Dongmo or not, his desire for this woman was genuine - he wanted to hold her if he could.

With a snap, a slap hit him on the face——

"Who do you think you are? Can you just grab any woman and kiss her whenever you want? Damn it, why did you kiss me! Did you forget that you still have your fiancée Lan Lin?"

"She is not my fiancée." He said calmly, accepting her slap willingly.

Xi Wu stared at him angrily."Even if it is not now, it will be in the future. Isn't your cooperative relationship based on a possible marriage contract?"

Zuo Yuen told her this personally!

Saito Hideki twitched his lips."You care about this?"

He smiled.

He actually fucking laughed?

"Of course I don't care!" She was almost pissed off by him."Don't you understand the point? The point is that you shouldn't kiss me! You shouldn't kiss a random stranger! And that's when there are other women around you! When did you become so flirtatious and sentimental?"

Saito Hideki narrowed his eyes upon hearing this and looked at her thoughtfully."Did you know me before? If not, how did you know that I had changed?"

"Of course I... don't know you!" Xi Wu really wanted to bite off her tongue."It's just that when I work in a magazine, I always hear more insider information."

"The inside story also includes knowing whether I used to take care of myself? Wasn't I romantic? That's really interesting." He snorted a few times and looked at her mockingly.

Xi Wu's eyes widened guiltily."That's not the point, okay? The point is, how can you kiss me without my permission, without even asking!"

Saito Hideki smiled."Will you say yes if I ask?"

"Of course not."

"So why do I ask?"

Well said!How rude and overbearing!I wonder if this is the nature of this man?Or does it get worse as you grow up?

Xi Wu glared at him again, turned around and left.

"Your glasses," he reminded kindly.

Hearing this, she turned around and took the glasses back from his hand before walking out again.

The moment her hand grasped the doorknob, Saito Hideki's voice came coldly again——

"Are you sure we've never met before? You have no impression of me at all?"

Holding the doorknob's hand tightly, Xi Wu took a deep breath and said, "I'm sure I didn't know you before, and I don't want to know you in the future."

She opened the door and left. She didn't look back, and she didn't dare to look back. She could only walk straight forward.

She wants to forget him...

Don't be sad anymore...

In the room, Saito Hideki, who was watching her leave, picked up his cell phone and made a call——

"Help me find a person named Xi Wu, and send someone to follow her..."

Chapter 13(1)

"Xi Wu! Wait for me!" Seeing her rushing forward as soon as she came out, Zuo Yuen hurriedly followed her, shouting after her. When he finally caught up with her, he couldn't help but be startled when he saw the tears on her face."Xi Wu... what's wrong with you? Why are you crying? Did Hideki Saito bully you?"

"I'm fine, I'm fine." Xi Wu stretched out her hand to wipe away her tears, returned her glasses to her, and forced a smile to Zuo Yuen."How's it going? Do you have any photos that you're satisfied with?"

Zuo Yuen easily put his glasses back on and nodded."Well, there are several pictures that I am very, very satisfied with. You did a great job taking him...but I think he is a hateful person. He actually made you cry. He is not worthy of the image in these pictures at all!"

He was actually very good, he just did bad things to her.

Xi Wu wanted to say this, but she couldn't say it, and she couldn't say it.

"Now that you have satisfactory photos, can you treat me to a feast? I'm so hungry now." Xi Wu stroked his stomach pitifully.
